description: The US tariff layers of one HTS code from 2 to 6 countries of origin, side by side, lowest total first. Duty only: freight, fees and supplier price are not compared. Planning estimate, not a customs ruling.

hts.description: HTSUS code, 4 to 10 digits, dots optional, e.g. "6109.10.00". An 8- or 10-digit line is priced from that line; a shorter code is an estimate.

origins.description: 2 to 6 countries of origin (ISO-2 codes or English names), e.g. ["CN", "VN", "MX"].

name: compare_origins
title: Compare US tariffs by origin
